latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Now includes strict security rules and clearer guidance for chat-based users and agents.

- Added explicit security rules: Never echo or store real Playasia tokens and always use a placeholder in all examples.
- New "Web chat clients" section explains workflow for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, etc. with clear steps for searching, price checks, and purchases.
- Strong warning to never invent or fabricate product info, prices, or codes without live API data.
- All purchase/authentication examples now consistently use the token placeholder pa_YOUR_TOKEN_HERE.
- Documentation clarified on how agents must disclose limitations and interact securely with users.
